params.prompt: A minimalist, premium line-art illustration of a single path splitting into two: one branch leading to a small briefcase icon, the other to a small rupee-coin icon, rendered in thin gold (#C9A227) linework on a warm off-white (#FBF6EF) background with a subtle deep-indigo (#241E4E) horizon shadow.
